workoutName: W9 Vert session — stair machine or treadmill incline
description: Hellbender 100 plan · week 9 · target 420 ft vert

workoutSteps.description: Flat or low incline.

Stair machine (StepMill) preferred — far steeper than a treadmill's 15% ceiling. DO NOT hold the handrail; it removes a large and unrecorded share of the work. Treadmill at max incline is the alternative. Neither trains DESCENDING, which is what actually breaks down at Hellbender — that is what the mountain weekends and the eccentric strength work are for. ** HEEL WATCH: steep climbing holds the ankle in dorsiflexion, which drives the shoe's heel counter into the back of the calcaneus — the exact mechanism
Flat, easy.

workoutSteps.description: Easy. Walk breaks from the start if hilly.

30.1 mi point-to-point, ~9,200 ft, Davidson River to Camp Daniel Boone. NOT a race — a big unsupported day, and the largest single effort before the Heartbreaker. Budget 9 h; it may take 11-12 and that is fine. BAIL POINT: FS 816 at Black Balsam, roughly two-thirds in and road-accessible — if you are more than 2 h over budget by Gloucester Gap (mile 12.3), stop there instead. Needs a car shuttle at both ends. February on the balds is genuinely exposed: this is the cold-kit test for Hellbender's 6,684 ft sum
Easy walk/jog. Eat within 30 minutes.

workoutSteps.description: Easy. Walk breaks from the start if hilly.

Stair machine (StepMill) preferred — far steeper than a treadmill's 15% ceiling. DO NOT hold the handrail; it removes a large and unrecorded share of the work. Treadmill at max incline is the alternative. Neither trains DESCENDING, which is what actually breaks down at Hellbender — that is what the mountain weekends and the eccentric strength work are for. ** HEEL WATCH: steep climbing holds the ankle in dorsiflexion, which drives the shoe's heel counter into the back of the calcaneus — the exact mechanism
Easy walk/jog. Eat within 30 minutes.
